description: Implement a consistent clearing API contract across all backends and viewports. Ensure that clear operations have predictable, observable behavior regarding cursor cell inclusion and region boundaries. Fix viewport clearing to respect viewport boundaries rather than clearing outside the visible area.
functional_requirements: Define and implement a clear contract where clears operate on character cells in the visible display area, cursor position is preserved, and the cursor cell is included when within the cleared region
Align TestBackend's AfterCursor/BeforeCursor clearing behavior to match real backend implementations (CSI J) by making them inclusive of the cursor cell
Modify fixed viewport clearing to only clear within the viewport region boundaries, even when the viewport is not full width
Restore original cursor position after Terminal::clear operations to maintain the contract's cursor preservation guarantee
Implement efficient clearing strategies for viewports that span full width or reach the bottom of the display
